title: Current partial-withdrawal framework
scope: Only the 12-month minimum service requirement, the 75-percent balance limit, and the stated balance composition for the MVP partial-withdrawal rules.
notes: No other withdrawal limits, categories, conditions, or procedures are derived from these pages in Phase 2.

title: Online transfer Date-of-Exit prerequisite
scope: Only the requirement that Date of Exit for previous employment is mandatory for an online transfer application.
notes: The broader FAQ contains legacy or stale guidance in unrelated sections and is not trusted wholesale.

title: Official EPFO form and process labels
scope: Only process-label mapping: Form 31 for withdrawal in certain cases, Form 13 for transfer of an old account to a new account, and Form 19 for final settlement.
notes: These labels are metadata and do not establish eligibility.
